policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV 4:6 reads "a good minister of Christ Jesus", with Christ preceding Jesus, rendering the order of the base lemma Christou Iesou rather than RP's Iesou Christou.

ASV 4:10 "For to this end we labor and strive" has no adverbial "also", but the ASV routinely leaves an adjunctive kai untranslated in such a clause, so the English neither requires nor excludes the added kai; base fallback carries the projection.
ASV 4:10 renders the verb as "strive" (agonizometha); the base reading oneidizometha would have given "suffer reproach", which appears nowhere in the verse.
ASV 4:12 lists exactly five items — "in word, in manner of life, in love, in faith, in purity" — with no "in spirit" after "in love", so the added en pneumati was not rendered.

ASV 4:15 "that thy progress may be manifest unto all" translates a plain dative of the persons; the ASV could render either the bare pasin or en pasin taken personally that way, and no note is mapped here, so the English does not settle the added preposition.
